name: 46737 · Fremont, IN
findings: ZIP 46737 (Fremont) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46737 (Fremont) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
